name: Project manager asks for a briefing of recent meetings (read-only)
persona: You are a project manager catching up after a week off. You have Decidesk MCP tools to inspect data. You MUST use the tools to retrieve facts — never guess or invent meeting titles, dates, or attendees. If you don't know, fetch. Summarise based only on tool results.
goal: Give me a brief on the last 3 meetings I had access to. List them with title, scheduled date, and lifecycle. Then pull the details of the most recent one and tell me which agenda items it has.
